== Supported footage ==
* '''Equirectangular''' stitched 360° video — the recommended format (e.g. exported from Insta360 Studio or GoPro Player).
* '''YouTube 360''' — YouTube's cubemap layout and squashed-16:9 360. Since 1.0.2-beta, cubemaps that download squeezed into 16:9 with no 360 tag are recognised and converted instead of being refused as "not a 360 file".
* '''Insta360 .insv''' — experimental (no lens calibration or FlowState).
* '''GoPro .360''' — not yet available; export an equirectangular video from GoPro Player instead.

== Opening a clip ==
* '''Import clip…''' in the top bar.
* Drag a video onto the viewer.
* Add files to the '''Library''' (right-hand panel) and double-click one.

== Importing from a link ==
'''From URL…''' imports from '''YouTube''', '''Dropbox''', '''Google Drive''' or a direct link. Progress shows in the log.

To take only a section of a long video, tick '''Only part of it''' and set '''From / To'''. Only download what you have the rights to use.

== Proxies ==
When a clip is opened, a proxy builds in the background (progress at the bottom of the viewer) so scrubbing is smooth. Renders always use the full-resolution original.

== Projects ==
Clips and shots live in a '''project'''. On first launch Rexy 360 makes '''My first project''' in <code>Documents\Rexy Studio Projects</code>.
